Dehumain token · Envisioned for Robinhood Chain

An identity today.
An intelligence tomorrow.

Dehumain begins with Dehumain token: one token bringing a population together. After migration, qualifying holders can mint the face of their future AI agent.

Hold at least US$5 worth of Dehumain token under the published eligibility rules to claim one free Dehumain NFT per eligible wallet, while supply lasts. Additional mints cost US$5 worth of ETH each. Collectors pay network gas on every mint.

Your NFT is your identity. Activation is your choice. When agents become available, holders can pay an activation fee to pair their NFT with a released AI-agent type. Every Dehumain NFT is designed to be eligible for pairing.

One token. Many identities.
A growing range of intelligence.

The work ahead

A face becomes a presence.

Token launch, migration, minting and AI-agent activation are planned. Migration details, eligibility timing, valuation sources and milestone verification will be published before launch. Activation pricing and usage allowances are still being defined.

Market-cap milestones describe the planned release schedule. They are not a promise of token value or financial returns. Minting an NFT does not automatically activate an agent.
